dialogues.title: Completion
dialogues.message: Congratulations! You have completed the level

dialogues.title: Story
dialogues.message: Special Agent Nut enters the final level, you can almost see home.

dialogues.title: Story
dialogues.message: A sudden gust of icy wind howls through the trees and snow coming down on their head.

dialogues.title: Story
dialogues.message: Agent Nut sees the once familiar path home is now buried beneath a blanket of snow.

dialogues.title: Story
dialogues.message: Agent Nut steps forward, his boots crunching against the frozen ground.

dialogues.title: Story
dialogues.message: In the distance, a faint light between the trees… could it be Home?

dialogues.title: Story
dialogues.message: Everything rests on this final stretch.
